title: Event envelope for every FraudShield Kafka message value

event_id.description: Unique per event; consumers deduplicate on it

event_type.description: Must equal the topic's event_type in topics.yaml

schema_version.description: Must equal the topic's schema_version in topics.yaml; a breaking payload change adds a new version (ADR 0012)

institution_id.description: Set by the producing FraudShield service from the authenticated principal (API key or staff token), never copied from client input (ADR 0012, tenant isolation)
